component.name: retromanager
component.summary: Browse, download and organize retro ROM collections

description.p: retromanager is a Linux-friendly retro library manager. It lets you browse ROM catalogues sourced from the Internet Archive, download individual titles with integrity verification (MD5, SHA1, CRC32), and organize your local collection. Grid and list views show Libretro box-art thumbnails. Optional integration with RetroArch and Lutris lets you launch games directly.

ul.li: Background downloads with progress, speed, and pause/resume
Grid view with Libretro box-art thumbnails
Favorites and wishlist, persisted across sessions
RetroArch playlist integration and direct launch

description.p: Use only with files and sources you are legally allowed to access.
Initial public release of the retromanager fork.
